basic.name: Shadow Mark
basic.description:
Shoot a Void Orb that deals 65~~0.04~~ damage to enemies hit, and an additional 130~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in the center.

If an enemy Hero or Structure is hit by the center, they are marked for 4 seconds.

Targets afflicted by Shadow Mark are Revealed and draw the Dark Heart and Void Minions towards them.

basic.name: Dark Heart Ritual
basic.description:
Summon the Dark Heart, which pulses for 50~~0.04~~ damage per second to nearby enemies and lasts 8 seconds.

The Dark Heart moves to Shadow Mark's impact location.

The Dark Heart will pursue targets afflicted by Shadow Mark and detonate on impact, dealing 260~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies and 65~~0.04~~ more damage to the Marked target.

basic.name: Void Step
basic.description:
Cast to teleport Xal'atath 3 times in a triangular pattern.

Each time Xal'atath teleports, her Basic Attacks deal 15% more damage while the Ability is active.

Reactivate to end Void Step early and remain at your current location.

heroic.name: Void Eruption
heroic.description:
Channel a powerful Void Orb that grows over time until reaching maximum size after 2 seconds. Recast to launch the Orb early.

Enemies that come into contact with the Orb take 81~~0.04~~ damage and are Blinded for 1 second.

When the Orb reaches the end of its path, it detonates in a large explosion, dealing 320~~0.04~~ damage.

Charging up this Ability increases its contact damage up to 81~~0.04~~ and its explosion damage up to 320~~0.04~~.

Contact damage is dealt every 0.25 seconds.

heroic.name: Void Convergence
heroic.description:
After channeling for 2 seconds, summon a Void Portal that spawns up to 3 Void Minions to attack nearby enemies.

You can have up to 1 active Void Portal.

Enemies near the Void Portal are Slowed by 25%.

Void Minions are attracted to targets afflicted by Shadow Mark.

The Portal expires after 20 seconds.
Void Minions automatically choose a nearby lane to push.
Void Minion Basic Attacks deal 50~~0.04~~ damage per hit.
Void Minions lose Health over 12 seconds.

trait.name: Void Volley
trait.description:
Every basic attack against heroes, and every 2 basic attacks against non-heroes generate charge. Once fully charged Xal'atath can activate Void Volley to unleash a barrage of 6 Void Orbs at a target location, each dealing 72~~0.04~~ damage on impact.

Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Void Volley to grant 1 stack per hit and increases Void Volley's damage by 0.75%. Lose all stacks upon dying.

Reward (20 Stacks):
   +2 Void Volley Range
   Stack loss on death lowered to 6.

Reward (60 Stacks):
   -1 Basic Attack required to charge Void Volley.

Mythic Reward (100 Stacks):
   +35% Basic Attack and Void Volley Damage.
   Void Volley projectiles Pierce all targets.

Stack loss will never cause the Hero to fall below a quest reward threshold.
Charge fully decays if Xal’atath does not hit an enemy with a Basic Attack after 6 seconds.

level1.name: Void Adept
level1.description:
Quest: Detonate the Dark Heart on targets afflicted by Shadow Mark.

Each successful detonation permanently increases Shadow Mark and the Dark Heart Ritual Detonation damage by 20, up to 10 times.

level1.name: Anchored Core
level1.description:
+25% Dark Heart Ritual Radius

Dark Heart's damage bounces 2 times from the primary target to nearby enemies, dealing 25~~0.04~~ damage.

level1.name: Cloak of Shadows
level1.description: Activating Void Step grants 25 Spell Armor while teleporting and 50% Movement Speed for 2 seconds afterwards.

level4.name: Cold Feet
level4.description:
+2s Shadow Mark Duration

Heroes afflicted by Shadow Mark have their Movement Speed reduced by 25%.

level4.name: Dark Barrier
level4.description: Each time the Dark Heart damages an enemy Hero, Xal'atath gains a Shield equal to 2% of her maximum Health, up to 10%.

level4.name: Void Acolyte
level4.description:
Completing Void Step fully charges Void Volley.

The next Void Volley deals 25% increased damage and costs no Mana.

level7.name: Toxic Mark
level7.description: Heroes affliced with Shadow Mark have their Armor reduced by 10 and take damage equal to 1% of their maximum Health every second.

level7.name: Silence of the Lamb
level7.description: Activating Void Step summons a seal of void magic on the ground. When the seal completes, it deals 250~~0.04~~ damage to enemies inside and Silences them for 2 seconds.

level7.name: Void Summoner
level7.description:
Activating Void Step summons a single Void Minion in Xal'atath's original postion. Void Minions are attracted to targets afflicted by Shadow Mark.

Void Minions automatically choose a nearby lane to push.
Void Minion Basic Attacks deal 50~~0.04~~ damage per hit.
Void Minion loses Health over 12 seconds.

level13.name: Pull of the Dark Heart
level13.description: Enemies damaged by the Dark Heart Ritual are Slowed by 10% for each pulse, stacking up to 5 times and decaying over 2 seconds.

level13.name: Dark Heart's Protection
level13.description:
Detonating the Dark Heart now Silences enemies inside its radius for 1 second.

Xal'atath and allied Heroes gain 30 Spell Armor while inside the Dark Heart's radius.

level13.name: Crushing Cascade
level13.description: Enemies hit by Void Volley are Slowed by 6% for 2 seconds per projectile, up to 50%.

level16.name: Marked Resilience
level16.description:
Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes afflicted by Shadow Mark grant a 0~~NaN~~ point Shield that rapidly decays.

Shield starts decaying after 1 second, decays over 2 seconds.

level16.name: Relentless Whispers
level16.description: Increases the Basic Attack damage bonus per teleport by 75%.

level16.name: Fractured Reality
level16.description:
+15% Void Volley Projectile Damage

Void Volley's projectiles leave behind a trail of fire for 3 seconds, constantly dealing 9~~0.04~~ damage to enemies. Damage is increased the longer a target stands in the flames.

Damage is dealt every 0.1875 seconds.
Damage increases up to 300%.
Damage increase from multiple fires stack.

level20.name: Harbinger's Consumption
level20.description: Void Eruption splits into 3 orbiting Void Orbs. Each enemy Hero hit by their explosions reduces Void Eruption's cooldown by 10 seconds.

level20.name: Rift Invasion
level20.description: Void Convergence's Void Portal self decay is no longer lethal, raises the active Void Portal limit to 2, and can spawn and sustain up to 4 Void Minions.

level20.name: Dueling Orbs
level20.description:
+1 Shadow Mark Charge

Shadow Mark has a 3 second cooldown between uses.

level20.name: Unstable Core
level20.description:
When the Dark Heart expires or detonates, it leaves behind a pool of void flames for 6 seconds, dealing up to 450~~0.04~~ to enemies in the area.

Deals 75~~0.04~~ damage every 1 second.

level20.name: Paradox Loop
level20.description:
After completing Void Step, Xal'atath immediately performs a second Void Step in the opposite direction. Added effects are triggered again.

Bonus Basic Attack damage stacks up to 3 times
